headline: Petitions for a venue alteration, a used car dealer license, a manager change, and a seasonal license extension.
summary: Three businesses have new petitions on the agenda. The commission will also discuss a seasonal license extension for Pit Stop Food N Fuel Inc.
items: Alteration of licensed premises for Ivy's Events LLC dba Ivy's Events The Venue at 1295 Liberty Street; manager of record Mary Irizarry
New Car Dealer, Class II (Used Car) license for Pioneer Valley Auto Group LLC dba Pioneer Valley Auto Group at 1469 State Street; manager of record Mohammad Abidallah
Change of manager from David C. Alves to Patricia Leavitt for B.P.O.E Springfield Lodge No. 61 dba B.P.O.E Springfield Lodge at 440 Tiffany Street
Discussion of seasonal license extension request for Pit Stop Food N Fuel Inc dba Pit Stop Food N Fuel Inc at 736-740 Boston Rd; manager of record Hardik Gogri
location: Room 205, 2nd Floor, City Hall, 36 Court Street (also via Zoom)
